description_for_human: Decentralized AI-powered voice recording platform. Create, transform, and share voice notes on-chain.
description_for_model: VOISSS is a decentralized voice platform on Base blockchain. Use this plugin to: 1) Generate AI voices from text using ElevenLabs, 2) Browse available voice themes/missions for recording, 3) Submit voice recordings to themed missions, 4) Check platform stats and agent credits. Supports x402 micropayments, prepaid credits, and token-gated tiers. All recordings are stored on IPFS with on-chain provenance.

vocalize.description: Generate AI voice audio from text

submit.description: Submit a voice recording to a theme

register.description: Register an agent for API access
